name: pocket-photos
description: Self-hosted Google Photos-like server for photos and videos. Runs on Android (Termux) with an external SSD, or any machine with Node.js.

scripts.build: npm run check && tsc -p tsconfig.server.json && tsc -p tsconfig.frontend.json && tsc -p tsconfig.admin.json && vite build
scripts.check: tsc -p tsconfig.server.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.frontend.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.admin.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.ui.json
